pairs.zh: 依据你自己的记录，提供一个小建议。

pairs.zh: 此预览使用简单匹配规则，尚未连接真实 AI 模型。

pairs.en: Sample one-time amount. Final scope and price require confirmation.

pairs.en: Gentle synthesized guidance. Adjust the sound as you wish.

pairs.zh:
把小小的照顾，
放进一天。
在页面内滚动时间轴，按自己的生活调整节奏。
pairs.en: Scroll your timeline. Adjust the rhythm to fit your life.

pairs.zh: 这里的时间用于安排日常节奏；当前预览不提供系统闹钟或后台提醒。
pairs.en: Times help you plan your day. System alarms and background notifications are not enabled in this preview.

pairs.zh: 有记录的日子，是一次照顾；留白的日子，也可以。
pairs.en: Every recorded day is a moment of care. Blank days are welcome too.

pairs.zh:
用自己的话，
回看内心的天气。
pairs.en:
Your inner weather,
in your own words.

pairs.zh: 这些是自己的记录，不是诊断或评分。
pairs.en: Your own records, not a diagnosis or a score.

pairs.zh: 你的文字与感受，会保存在这里。
pairs.en: Your own words and feelings will appear here.

pairs.zh:
把日常的点滴，
慢慢看见。
回看自己的觉察、感受与练习，发现属于你的生活节奏。
pairs.en: Reflections, feelings and moments of practice, kept in your own words.

pairs.zh: 这里呈现真实记录，不生成临床评分，也不把每一天评为好坏。
pairs.en: These records describe your own experience. They do not generate clinical scores or promise an improvement.

pairs.zh: 签到、觉察、抽卡与练习后，你的点滴记录就会出现在这里。
pairs.en: Your check-ins, reflections, cards and practice records will appear here when you use them.

pairs.zh: 记录仅保存在当前浏览器，暂不跨设备同步。清除浏览器数据会同时移除记录。
pairs.en: Records are saved in this browser, without account sync. Clearing browser data removes them.

日常练习、记录和时间轴持续可用。需要更深入的支持时，再了解这些可选路径。
pairs.en: Your daily practices and records stay available. Explore these optional paths when they feel useful.

pairs.en: A structured series, alongside your everyday practice.

pairs.zh: 在需要的时候，了解一次专门的交流。
pairs.en: Explore a dedicated conversation, if you need one.

pairs.zh:
让日常节奏，

pairs.zh: 结合偏好安排更长周期的个人节奏
pairs.en: An extended personal rhythm, based on your preferences

pairs.zh: 服务提案，提供方、具体范围及费用尚未确定。
pairs.en: Proposed service. Provider, scope and price are not final.

pairs.zh: 不购买此服务，也能完整使用日常自评、觉察记录、所有基础练习和时间轴。
pairs.en: Daily check-ins, reflections, all basic practices and the timeline remain available without this service.

pairs.zh:

pairs.en: Rolling cards · You choose when to stop

留在这里。

pairs.en: Save a daily thought, reflection card, lesson or music track. Your first saved item will appear here.
A LOOK BACK AT YOUR DAYS

pairs.zh: 可以从今天的一小段真实体验开始。
pairs.en: Your first real practice can begin today.

pairs.zh: 这段时间还没有这类记录
可以换个时间或类型，也可以留下一次真实体验。
pairs.en: Change a filter or begin a small practice.

pairs.zh: 这里仅统计实际练习和聆听，全局APP计时独立记录。个人档案仍保存在当前浏览器，暂不完整跨设备同步。
pairs.en: Only actual practice and listening are counted here. App-open time is a separate ledger. Records remain local to this browser.

Let understanding
find a place in life.

pairs.zh: 辨认压力出现的情境，探索适合自己的停顿与回应。
pairs.en: Notice the context of pressure and explore a pause that fits you.

pairs.zh: 从自己的生活节奏出发，认识休息与恢复的日常空间。
pairs.en: Explore where a pause can fit within your own daily rhythm.

pairs.zh: 随时可以开始的自然呼吸觉察，给此刻一个小停顿。
pairs.en: A brief awareness of natural breathing, whenever you need a pause.

pairs.zh: 认识传统背景、常见方法与日常学习的边界。
pairs.en: Understand the tradition, different approaches and the scope of learning.

pairs.zh: 从身体、呼吸与注意力的协调，认识东方身心练习。
pairs.en: Explore coordination of posture, breathing and attention.

pairs.zh: 让身体有支撑，安放双手，留意一次自然呼吸。
pairs.en: Find support, rest your hands and notice a natural breath.

pairs.zh: 了解紫微斗数的命盘结构，区分传统符号与自己的真实经历。
pairs.en: Explore the chart structure and distinguish symbols from your own experience.

pairs.zh: 从基础词汇开始，用清楚的语境理解传统体系。
pairs.en: Begin with basic vocabulary and clear context for the tradition.

pairs.zh: 给专注留一点空间，再写下一个属于自己的选择。
pairs.en: Make room for attention, then choose one step of your own.

pairs.zh: 按自己的节奏学习，收藏的内容随时可以回来继续。
pairs.en: Learn at your own pace. Saved courses remain ready to revisit.

pairs.zh: 区分事实、感受与需要，写下一个贴近自己的意向。
pairs.en: Separate an observation, a feeling and a need, then choose an intention.

pairs.zh: 非会员课程 · 原创短读
今天发生的一件事、我的感受，以及我想照顾的一个需要。
pairs.en: One thing that happened, how I felt, and one need I would like to care for.

pairs.zh: 日常康养学习内容，请结合自己的感受与实际情况体验。
pairs.en: General wellbeing learning, with room for your own experience.

pairs.zh: 选择一段声音，留一点空间
pairs.en: Choose a sound. Make a little space.

pairs.zh: 轻盈的五声音阶与温暖和弦，陪伴清晨或短暂休息。
pairs.en: Light pentatonic notes and warm chords for a morning or a small pause.

pairs.zh: 缓慢交替的和弦与疏朗旋律，留一段安静时光。
pairs.en: Slowly changing chords and spacious notes for a little quiet time.

pairs.zh: 低音域和声缓缓展开，适合晚间安静聆听。
pairs.en: Soft, low-register harmonies unfold slowly for an evening of quiet listening.

pairs.zh: 选择声音后，可调整音量与聆听时长。
pairs.en: Choose a sound, then adjust volume and listening duration.

pairs.zh: 遇到不熟悉的事，我愿意提问和尝试。
pairs.en: I like to ask questions and try things that are unfamiliar.

pairs.zh: 当选择很多时，我真正看重什么？今天可以先走哪一小步？
pairs.en: When there are many options, what matters to me? What small step could I choose today?

pairs.zh:
读懂传统符号，
保留自己的理解。
pairs.en:
Read the symbols.
Keep your own perspective.

pairs.zh: 认识紫微斗数的基本语言，也为自我觉察提供一个文化视角。
pairs.en: An introduction to the language of Zi Wei Dou Shu and a starting point for reflection.

pairs.zh: 紫微斗数依据出生资料，将星曜安排在十二宫中。本页介绍它的文化语言与命盘结构；它并非科学人格测量。
pairs.en: Zi Wei Dou Shu arranges named stars within twelve palaces using birth details. Here, we introduce its cultural vocabulary and show the chart structure. It is not a scientific personality measurement.

pairs.zh: 命盘传统解读的重要参照。它是文化术语，不是对一个人的完整定义。
pairs.en: A central reference in the chart’s traditional interpretation. It is a cultural term, not a complete definition of who you are.

pairs.zh: 落在某个宫位中的另一项传统参照，不代表人体器官或身体检测结果。
pairs.en: Another reference marked within a palace. It does not describe an organ or provide a physical assessment.

pairs.zh: 按传统规则排布的命名符号。盘中的星名不等于对天空实体天体的实时观测。
pairs.en: Named symbols arranged according to traditional rules. A star name on this chart is not an observation of a physical object in the sky.

pairs.zh: 十二个宫位组织命盘结构。下方保留传统名称，觉察问题则是本应用提供的现代反思提示。
pairs.en: Twelve areas organise the chart. Their traditional names offer a way to explore the culture; the reflection questions below are written for this app.

pairs.zh: “疾厄”等名称仅按传统术语介绍，不由命盘推断疾病、寿命或命定结果。
pairs.en: Traditional names such as the health palace are explained as vocabulary only. We do not infer illness, lifespan or a predetermined future from a chart.

pairs.en: iztro · Basic vocabulary and time branches

展开生命地图。
pairs.en:
A cultural view
of your life map.

pairs.zh: 传统排盘 · 文化探索
命盘呈现传统符号排布，不作为科学人格画像，也不推断健康、寿命或命定结果。
pairs.en: The chart shows a traditional arrangement of symbols, not a scientific personality profile or a prediction of health, lifespan or destiny.

pairs.zh: 阳历出生日期 · 已确认的 UTC+8 口径
pairs.en: Gregorian birth date · confirmed UTC+8 basis

pairs.zh: 选择已确认的出生时辰
传统排盘使用男／女二元参数，仅作为算法输入，不用于定义个人身份。
pairs.en: The traditional calculation uses a male/female parameter. This is an algorithm input, not a statement about gender identity.

pairs.zh: 本页采用你输入的日期与时辰，不自动换算时区、夏令时或校正真太阳时。若出生地不在 UTC+8，或可能涉及夏令时，请先确认所采用的日期与时辰。
pairs.en: This page uses the date and time branch you enter. It does not convert time zones, adjust daylight saving or calculate true solar time. If you were born outside UTC+8, or daylight saving may apply, first confirm the date and time branch to use.

pairs.zh: 我已确认用于本次排盘的阳历日期与出生时辰（UTC+8 口径）。
pairs.en: I have confirmed the Gregorian date and birth time branch to use on a UTC+8 basis.

pairs.zh: 生成命盘仅作临时使用；之后主动选择“保存出生资料”，才会保存在当前浏览器。
pairs.en: Generating is temporary. Details are saved in this browser only if you choose Save afterwards.

pairs.zh: 了解命盘术语与文化背景
排盘方法 · iztro 官方文档

把日子，
过成自己的方向。
留意真正重要的事，从一个小小的意向开始。
pairs.en: Notice what matters, and choose one small intention.

pairs.zh: 今天，你想为哪件事留一点空间？
pairs.en: What would you like to make room for?

pairs.zh: 休息、连接、慢一点……由你自己选择。
pairs.en: Rest, connection, a slower pace — let it be your choice.

pairs.zh: 记录今天留意到的一个优势。
记录一次被听见或被理解的时刻。
pairs.en: A moment of being heard or understood.

pairs.zh: 我的下一个小行动是什么？
pairs.en: What is my next small step?

pairs.zh: 写下自主选择的成长方向。
pairs.en: One direction I choose for myself.

pairs.zh: 这里记录你的观察与选择，不计算命运分数或自动预测。
pairs.en: Your own observations and choices. No destiny score or automatic forecast.

pairs.zh: 四个问题，留意自己的感受
pairs.en: Four questions about your own experience
Save and find a starting point

pairs.zh: 建议依据自述与练习反馈，不是设备测量或医疗判断。
pairs.en: These rules use your own answers, not device measurements or a medical diagnosis.

pairs.zh: 从温和的呼吸和身体觉察开始，按自己的舒适程度练习。
pairs.en: Begin with natural breathing and body awareness, at a comfortable pace.

pairs.zh: 导引是东方传统中结合身体活动、呼吸与注意力的练习方式。这里提供日常觉察练习，可从短时体验开始。

Choose a little time to be here

pairs.zh: 自然呼吸，按自己的节奏
pairs.en: Natural breathing, at your own pace

pairs.zh:

pairs.en:
Understand the teaching.
Bring it into life.

pairs.zh: 三篇佛教语境下的原创入门导读，结合反思与日常行动。
pairs.en: Three original introductory readings in a Buddhist context, with reflection and small actions.

pairs.zh: 从安坐、观息与重新回来，认识禅修的一个入门路径。
pairs.en: Begin with quiet sitting, natural breathing and the act of returning.

pairs.zh: 非会员课程 · 阅读 · 反思 · 实践
从一件日常小事，观察事情如何由多种条件共同形成。
pairs.en: Use an ordinary event to explore how several conditions contribute.

pairs.zh: 结合慈悲与智慧，练习理解他人并采取合适的行动。
pairs.en: Bring compassion and discernment together in how you respond.

pairs.zh: 内容为原创入门导读，不是经典原句或大师授权开示。每篇附有参考资料，便于继续了解。
pairs.en: These texts are original introductions, not scripture quotations or authorised teachings by a master. Reference links accompany each reading.

pairs.zh: 原创入门导读 · 三个小节
当注意力游离时，我通常怎样对待自己？今天愿意怎样重新回来？
pairs.en: How do I treat myself when attention wanders? How would I like to return today?

pairs.zh: 在下一次喝水时暂时放下屏幕，留意拿杯、入口与放下的过程。
pairs.en: At your next drink, set the screen aside and notice lifting, drinking and setting the cup down.

pairs.zh: 以上为佛教语境下的原创入门介绍。进一步修学，可结合完整的教义学习与具资质老师的指导。
pairs.en: An original introduction in a Buddhist context. It does not replace a complete study of the tradition or guidance from a qualified teacher.

pairs.zh: 以上为原创入门导读，以下资料供延伸阅读；相关机构未对本 App 作授权或背书。
pairs.en: Original introductory writing, informed by the resources below. These institutions have not endorsed or authorised this app.

pairs.zh: 法鼓山 · 禅坐为何要从体验呼吸开始？
pairs.en: Dharma Drum Mountain · Why meditation begins with the breath

pairs.zh: 法鼓山传灯院 · 禅修入门
pairs.en: Dharma Drum Mountain · Introduction to Chan practice

pairs.zh: 现在的你，更接近哪种感受？
pairs.en: Which feeling is closest to you now?
What would you like to note?

pairs.zh: 媒体内容准备中，可先阅读课程导读。
pairs.en: Media is being prepared. Explore the reading guide.

pairs.zh: 这份内容的参考出处资料待补充。
pairs.en: Reference details have not been supplied for this item.

pairs.zh: 参考链接不代表正式课程授权，老师及授权资料需按实际发布内容提供。
pairs.en: A reference link does not establish course authorization. Formal teacher and licensing details need to be supplied separately.

pairs.zh: 原创入门短读 · 三个小节
最近哪件事让我感到压力？今天我能调整哪一个具体安排？
pairs.en: What has felt demanding recently, and what concrete arrangement could I adjust today?

pairs.zh: 为下一段忙碌之前留一分钟，体验一次自然呼吸。
pairs.en: Before your next busy period, make one minute to notice natural breathing.

pairs.zh: 内容为原创入门导读，不是古籍原文、专业授课录音或大师授权开示。
pairs.en: This is original introductory writing, not a quotation from a classic, a professional lecture recording or an authorised master’s teaching.

pairs.zh: 这是你的AI对话空间，可以聊聊情绪、日常练习或东方智慧。
pairs.en: Your AI conversation space for feelings, everyday practice, and Eastern wisdom.

pairs.zh: 例如：最近很难静下心来…
pairs.en: For example: I find it hard to settle my mind…

pairs.zh: AI内容仅供参考 · 对话不会自动公开到社群
pairs.en: AI responses are for reference · Conversations are not automatically shared

pairs.zh:
从真实记录，
读懂自己的状态。
只呈现你保存的回答与记录。选择一份报告，再查看基础解析。
pairs.en: Only saved answers and notes appear here. Choose a report before interpreting it.

pairs.zh: 这四项回答描述的是记录当时的感受，可以结合起来理解。它们不是器官检测或临床评分；不同时刻的感受也可能变化。
pairs.en: The four answers describe how you felt when you recorded them. Read them together; they are not organ readings or a clinical score. A later check-in can be different.

pairs.zh: 这是你选择的自我观察结果，不是经过验证的能力测验或固定人格类型。重点是发现可以调用的优势，并通过真实体验不断修正理解。
pairs.en: These are observations you selected, not a validated ability test or fixed personality type. The goal is to notice strengths you can use and revise your view through experience.

pairs.zh: 情绪是一种体验，不是诊断或对人格的评判。文字记录提供了当时的情境，单次记录不能代表长期模式。
pairs.en: A feeling is an experience, not a diagnosis or a judgment of your character. Your notes give context; a single entry cannot establish a lasting pattern.

pairs.zh: 这些记录来自你主动选择的问题与意向，不会替你指定人生任务或预测未来。处境变化时，可以再次回看并调整。
pairs.en: These notes reflect the questions and intentions you chose. They do not assign you a life task or predict your future. Revisit the words when your situation changes.

pairs.zh: 已保存命盘 · 传统符号体系
这是传统命盘的文化说明，不是科学人格测量、医学结论或命运预测。本摘要不包含出生日期与时辰；如需核对输入和排盘口径，请打开原始命盘。
pairs.en: This is cultural context for a traditional chart, not a scientific personality measure, medical result or prediction. Birth date and time are excluded from this summary. Open the original chart to review its input and calculation basis.

pairs.zh: 逐份选择需要解析的报告。觉察文字与出生资料不会自动加入对话或分享至社群。
pairs.en: Reports are selected individually. Reflections and birth details are not automatically added to a conversation or shared with the community.

pairs.zh:
常见疑问，
在这里找到答案。
第一次使用，从哪里开始？
如何查看和理解我的报告？
pairs.en: How do I read my reports?

pairs.zh: 课程在哪里？会员与非会员怎么区分？
pairs.en: Where are courses and access labels?
How do I contact a human teacher?

pairs.zh: 如何添加好友、分享和聊天？
pairs.en: How do friends, sharing and chats work?

pairs.zh: 收藏、签到和成长记录在哪里？
pairs.en: Where are saved items and growth records?

pairs.zh: 疗愈 · 中医 · 紫微 · 禅修
体验视频播放与社群展示效果。
pairs.en: Preview video playback and the community layout.

pairs.zh: 上方为视频预览。老师和学员发布的内容，审核后会在这里展示。
pairs.en: The clip above is a preview. Community posts appear here after review.

pairs.zh: 自主发布 · 审核后公开 · 尊重每一次分享
pairs.en: Create freely · Public after review · Share with care

pairs.zh: 查找学员、打开会话，分享对自己有帮助的内容。
pairs.en: Find a learner, open a conversation and share what helped you.

pairs.zh: 可以按学员号查找。离线体验提供两位示例学员，用于体验好友与对话流程。
pairs.en: Search by learner ID. Offline previews include two example learners to try the flow.

pairs.zh: 离线体验 · 动态、通讯录与消息草稿仅保存在本浏览器。
pairs.en: Offline preview · Posts, contacts and message drafts stay in this browser.

What would you
like to talk about?

pairs.zh: 写下想讨论的问题，以及方便交流的时间。
pairs.en: Prepare your question and preferred time.

pairs.zh: 聊聊近期感受、基础报告与日常照顾。
pairs.en: Talk through a feeling, a report or a daily routine.

pairs.zh: 请教课程内容与温和练习中的疑问。
pairs.en: Bring questions about the learning content and practice steps.

pairs.zh: 理解传统术语，结合真实生活经验探索。
pairs.en: Understand traditional terms and reflect on your own experience.

pairs.zh: 交流静心练习与情绪觉察中的体验。
pairs.en: Discuss your meditation and reflection practice.

pairs.zh: 希望老师先了解你的哪些感受或困惑？
pairs.en: What would you like the teacher to understand first?

pairs.zh: 方便时段 · 本地时间
保存为本机需求草稿，尚未向老师提交或确认预约时段。
pairs.en: Save a local draft. It will not reserve a teacher, confirm a time or submit a paid booking.

pairs.zh:
带着问题来，
留一段交流时间。
pairs.en:
Bring a question.
Make room to talk.

pairs.zh: 选择想获得支持的方向，整理一份一对一服务需求。
pairs.en: Choose what you would like to discuss and prepare a one-to-one request.

pairs.zh: 接入老师服务后，可查看真实老师资料与可预约时段。当前可先整理需求并保存为草稿。
pairs.en: Teacher profiles and available appointments will be shown after the teacher service is connected. Requests below remain local drafts.

pairs.zh: 保存的一对一服务需求会显示在这里。
pairs.en: Your saved teacher request drafts will appear here.

pairs.zh:
用自己的名字，
开始一次交流。
填写你希望使用的昵称
昵称会用于本机动态预览。
pairs.en: Your name appears on local post previews.

pairs.zh: 此编号用于本机预览，不是已注册学员账号。真实好友查找需接入账号服务。
pairs.en: This is a preview identifier, not a registered learner account. Real friend discovery needs the account service.

pairs.zh:
分享一点，
属于自己的体验。
先看看想分享的文字与内容，再选择分享去向。
pairs.en: Preview the words and content before choosing where to share.
What I would like to share

pairs.zh: 一份感受、一次练习，或一个小小的发现…
pairs.en: A feeling, a practice, or a small discovery…

pairs.zh: 附上一句寄语、课程或音乐
pairs.en: Attach a thought, course or music

pairs.zh: 我的分享 · 本机预览
仅分享上方文字与附件，不附带个人报告、觉察日记或出生资料。离线分享将保存在本机。
pairs.en: Only the words and attached content above are included. Personal reports, journal entries and birth details are excluded. Offline sharing is saved locally.

pairs.zh: 打开APP自动累计，隐藏计时条仍继续。
pairs.en: Time starts automatically when you open the app. Hiding the widget keeps it running.

pairs.zh: 打开APP自动累计，无手动暂停。通过定期心跳识别退出和断线；超过45秒未收到心跳时结束旧会话，多窗口不重复计时。
pairs.en: App sessions accumulate automatically. There is no manual pause. Periodic heartbeats settle closed or disconnected sessions after 45 seconds; multiple tabs do not count twice.

pairs.zh: 练习和音乐的实际时长分别记录。
pairs.en: Practice and listening durations are recorded separately.

pairs.zh: 按自己的节奏，选择深入学习与支持。
pairs.en: Choose learning and support at your own pace.

pairs.zh: 开启你的深度成长之路。
pairs.en:
Continue your journey
in your own way.

pairs.zh: 根据此刻的需要，选择适合自己的支持。
pairs.en: Choose a level that suits the support you need.

pairs.zh:
多一份理解，
多一份陪伴。
pairs.en:
A little more understanding,
a little more support.

pairs.zh: 从适合自己的学习与支持开始，按需了解会员服务。
pairs.en: Discover the plan and benefits that feel useful to you.

pairs.zh:
适合自己的深度，
由自己选择。
先了解每项权益，再选择适合自己的方案。
pairs.en: Explore each benefit before choosing a plan.

pairs.zh: 老师服务、活动和礼包按各自说明提供；具体预约、活动名额与礼包领取信息会在对应页面展示。
pairs.en: Session bookings, event availability and gifts follow the individual service details. No session allowance or event capacity is invented here.

pairs.zh: 在智慧馆集中查看会员视频与有声书，覆盖疗愈、中医和紫微主题。课程介绍、章节与原创导读可以先了解，正式媒体资源按课程权益提供。
pairs.en: Explore member video and audiobook courses in healing, Chinese medicine and Zi Wei. Review introductions, chapters and reading guides before choosing.

pairs.zh:
沿着一个主题，
慢慢深入学习。
疗愈、中医、紫微 · 视频与有声书课程。
pairs.en: Healing, Chinese medicine and Zi Wei · Video and audiobook courses.

pairs.zh: 目前可查看课程介绍与原创导读，正式视频及有声书素材尚未配置。
pairs.en: Course introductions and original guides can be explored now. Formal video and audiobook media are not yet configured.

pairs.zh:
确认适合自己的，
会员方案。
，知悉当前为流程预览，不会实际扣款或开通付费会员。
pairs.en: and understand that this is a preview without payment or membership activation.

pairs.zh:
你的会员与权益，
在这里查看。
日常工具、基础练习、AI基础问答与社群基础功能持续可用。
pairs.en: Daily tools, basic practices, AI basic help and community basics are available.

pairs.zh: 查看等级对比与权益说明
pairs.en: Compare plans and view benefit details

pairs.zh: 了解会员与权益使用问题
确认会员开通信息后，可以在这里回看流程记录。
pairs.en: Confirmed membership previews will appear here.

pairs.zh:
为交流与共修，
留一个位置。
活动开放后会展示时间、地点与报名说明。
pairs.en: Dates, venues and booking information will appear when gatherings open.

pairs.zh:
一份心意，
陪伴日常修习。
暂无可领取的会员礼包
礼包开放后会展示内容、适用条件与领取说明。
pairs.en: Gift contents and collection instructions will appear when available.

pairs.zh: 回看自己留下的感受、觉察与练习记录。
pairs.en: Revisit your own observations and check-ins.

pairs.zh: 查看会员、老师服务需求与交流记录。
pairs.en: Membership, human teachers and your conversations.

pairs.zh: 收藏过的课程，可以在这里继续查看。
pairs.en: The courses you save are ready to revisit here.

pairs.zh: 把想学的课程留在这里
在智慧馆收藏课程，下次就可以在这里找到。
pairs.en: Save a course from Wisdom Hall to find it here next time.

pairs.zh: 本机浏览器保存觉察与偏好；通过本地服务打开时，发布、对话、设备授权与计时写入项目内的后台数据库。
pairs.en: This preview saves your reflections, preferences and time records in this browser. They are not synced to a cloud account.

pairs.zh: 清除浏览器数据会移除本机记录，但不会删除后台数据库。计时记录可在计时页导出。
pairs.en: Clearing browser data removes these records. Time records can be exported from the timer settings page.

pairs.zh: 账号用于发布内容、好友交流与设备数据。当前浏览器已有的个人记录继续保留。
pairs.en: Use your account for publishing, connections and devices. Existing local records stay here.
Up to 50 MB. MP4, WebM or MOV.

pairs.zh: 数据需经你授权后接入
仅展示你已授权设备提供的测量记录
pairs.en: Only measurements from devices you authorize
